steps: Layout: imported beeps-6s-vp9-opus.webm at 0-6.008 (beeps k..k+0.1 s), music at 7; Play from 0
Real click on 'Mute — ვიდეოს ორიგინალი ხმა' so the mute lands 40-100 ms before a beep (V2_2: 0.961 s; V2_4: 0.902 s)
Read master-tap RMS in the beep window 1.005-1.095 s
bugs.expected: R3-V2: while the video lane is muted, master RMS in the beep windows < -80 dBFS
bugs.actual: -52.3 dBFS when the mute lands 40 ms before the beep; -86.3 dBFS at 98 ms. Exponential decay ~0.58 dB/ms from GAIN_TIME_CONSTANT = 0.015 (setTargetAtTime), ~120 ms to reach -80 dBFS. Beeps fully after the ramp are -240 dBFS; unmute audible in 88 ms; video never paused, always muted, no source restarts; solo music silences video (-240).
